easyPrerequisites:
You have enough mana to cast Ornithopter.
You control at least one additional creature,
description:
Cast Ornithopter by paying its mana cost.
When Ornithopter enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Tradewind Rider by tapping it, Ornithopter and one other creature you control, returning Ornithopter from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
